Overview.Name: Talluri Abhigna
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Reducing PCOS-related issues, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday

Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & chicken curry (120 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) or  vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber slices

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid cluster beans and bitter gourd completely.
Follow vegetarian meals on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.
Reduce sweets and fried foods to improve PCOS symptoms and fat loss.
For boredom cravings, drink water first and wait 10 minutes before eating.
Get 20–30 minutes of morning sunlight exposure daily.
Regular yoga, better sleep and consistent meal timing will improve hormone balance and energy.
